statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum (fun n => Λ n * Λ (n+2)) / (X:ℝ); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → E X ≤ C*Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3/Real.sqrt X

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然推广 · TP-0057 · 在旧窄窗将高次幂污染压到 log X/√X
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · TP-0057 · Reduce proper-power contamination in the original window to log X/√X

brief.zh: 将每一端的坏项由单端 Λ 质量控制，另一端至多贡献一个对数因子。平方根计数和三重对数预算合成 log³ X/√X。用于 TP-0003 的提取及 TP-0015 的双矩转移。
brief.en: Bound bad terms using the Λ mass at either endpoint and at most one logarithmic factor at the other endpoint. Combine the square-root count with a log-cubed budget. This supports the extraction and moment transfer in TP-0003 and TP-0015.
